messages:
alex_chang: midweek handoff from me — quick capacity sanity check before I head offline in 2h. Pool-A (us-west) at ~72% utilization, burst headroom ~18k tokens/s, Pool-B (eu) at 88% with limited burst, Pool-C (apac) idle. Main risk: scheduled batch job 'invoice-indexer' starts 09:10 UTC and spikes embeddings.

maya_patel: noted. do you know the expected qps for invoice-indexer? can we throttle its worker count? :thinking_face:

alex_chang: invoice-indexer is set to 50 workers in k8s for today (was 30 yesterday after rollback). expected burst ~12k tokens/s. i'd prefer we throttle to 20 if we expect more external traffic.

sam_gomez: heads-up — I'm about to push canary for async-cache-priority which will increase KV cache churn on Pool-A. I can hold the rollout 30m if we want.

alex_chang: please hold. if invoice-indexer + canary hits simultaneously we risk hitting burst cap on Pool-A and triggering fallback to lower-capacity instances.

oncall_bot: reminder — quota auto-scaler check in 12m. Current quota windows: Pool-A burst cap 20k, Pool-B burst cap 10k.

jordan_lin: I can cover the 09:00-11:00 UTC window if someone wants to swap later. also happy to throttle jobs if you PR the change.

maya_patel: thx jordan. alex — can you drop the k8s patch for indexer to reduce workers to 20? I can deploy if you ping me.

alex_chang: doing a quick patch now. attaching the kubectl command i used locally: ```kubectl -n workloads scale deployment/invoice-indexer --replicas=20``` will push change in 2m and monitor.

sam_gomez: i'll pause the canary for 45m. leaving a note on the PR.

oncall_bot: metric spike alert (simulated) — Pool-B 5m avg CPU jumped 22% at 08:42 UTC. no action required yet.

maya_patel: monitoring grafana (https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pools) — keeping an eye on tail latency. if P95 > 300ms we fallback-route model to smaller-quantized variant.

jordan_lin: i'll take post-change watch. ping me in #eng-oncall if anything looks off. :thumbsup:

alex_chang: thanks everyone. summary for next oncall: reduced invoice-indexer to 20, held async-cache-priority canary, jordan covering 09-11 UTC, watch Pool-A burst headroom. leaving detailed notes in /handovers/midweek-1943210000.md.

maya_patel: ack, will update the runbook if fallback is triggered.

oncall_bot: handoff logged: /handovers/midweek-1943210000.md (author: alex_chang)
